🎬 John Adams (2008)

John Adams follows the extraordinary life of one of America’s most influential Founding Fathers, tracing his journey from a respected Massachusetts lawyer to a revolutionary leader and eventually the second President of the United States. Set during the turbulent years surrounding the American Revolution, the historical miniseries explores Adams’s passionate commitment to independence, justice, and the creation of a new nation. As tensions between the American colonies and Great Britain intensify, Adams becomes deeply involved in political debates and difficult decisions that ultimately lead to the Declaration of Independence. Working alongside influential figures such as Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Franklin, and George Washington, he helps shape the foundations of the United States while navigating political rivalries, disagreements, and the enormous pressures of leadership. Meanwhile, his devoted wife, Abigail Adams, provides emotional support, thoughtful advice, and a powerful perspective on the personal sacrifices required by his public responsibilities. As Adams travels abroad on diplomatic missions and later assumes the presidency, he faces difficult challenges involving international relations, political divisions, and the future of the young republic. Despite his achievements, his strong personality and uncompromising principles frequently place him at odds with fellow leaders. Combining detailed historical storytelling, powerful performances, political intrigue, and emotional family drama, John Adams explores patriotism, leadership, sacrifice, marriage, ambition, and the complicated struggle to establish American independence.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • History

⭐ IMDb: 8.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 7 episodes • Approximately 8h 21m total • TV-14

🎥 Director: Tom Hooper
